# Let's run get_pubchem_info again to see what it returns right now!
import urllib.request
import json

def get_pubchem_info(name):
    url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/{urllib.parse.quote(name)}/property/MolecularWeight,MolecularFormula,IUPACName/JSON"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    return data['PropertyTable']['Properties'][0]

print("ByName diiodomethane:", get_pubchem_info("diiodomethane"))
